_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits inside Hope with diverging thrust factors and only a -3% 30d move plus flat funding — classic coil; base rate favors HOLD until a named breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: partial split — analyst explicit HOLD/Hope; narrative describes downside pressure but does not name a phase shift
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays range-bound, fear_greed holds 63-70, funding near flat, no sustained ETF inflow impulse
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed breaks below ~55 with CVD/momentum suppressed (to Disbelief) or momentum reclaims 70s with ETF inflows and CVD reverse (to Optimism)
